rv.q: It is superficially lively but emotionally in the clouds.
Stephen Wilson stages it all with ample exuberance on Kenneth MacLeod’s colourful set, making good use of puppets for the Chicken Run-ish breakout from the zoo.
Undeniably bold, inclusive, and memorable, Jack and The Beanstalk: A New Moosical is a West End-worthy festive spectacle with dazzling puppetry and a star-making turn from McAdam.

Jack and The Beanstalk, Festival Theatre, Edinburgh ★★★★ Jack and The Beanstalk, Dundee Rep ★★★ Aladdin, Byre Theatre, St Andrews ★★★★ It’s been a late start for the Capital Theatres pantomime this year; but now here it comes, blazing across the big Festival Theatre stage in a dazzle of ever-shifting and wildly exciting LED light.

cn.t: This inventive "moosical" reimagining brings bold pizzazz and creativity to the classic tale, but its cynical take on Jack and hazy dramatization ultimately undermine the story's emotional heart, dividing critics.
